Welcome to the **Replication Registry**. This catalog lists replication packages from stub files in `papers/` (`<folder>.yml`), one row per study. Code, data, and artifacts live in **folder-backed study repos** or **package-backed** study packages linked from each stub.

For folder-backed studies, build display artifacts in the study repository:

```r
replicateEverything::build_study_artifacts(".")
```

For package-backed studies, use `build_report()` in the study package.

Verify precomputed files are present (run after clone or before Shiny):

```bash
Rscript scripts/validate_artifacts.R
```

Each replication script in a study repo follows a fixed layout: `library()` calls at the top, then analysis functions (`make_*`), then optional display functions (`format_*`), then a one-line execute footer that loads `data/...` and runs the pipeline.

Artifacts store **analysis output** (e.g. `.rds` model objects) when `replication.yml` defines a separate `format:` step; otherwise they store display-ready output (`.html`, `.png`). The Shiny app applies `format_*` at display time when registered.

```{r}
#| label: papers-table

library(yaml)

field_or <- function(x, default = "") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
}

format_authors <- function(authors) {
  if (is.null(authors)) {
    ""
  } else if (is.character(authors) && length(authors) == 1) {
    authors
  } else {
    paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
  }
}

doi_href <- function(doi) {
  doi <- trimws(field_or(doi))
  if (doi == "") return("")
  if (grepl("^https?://", doi, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(doi)
  }
  paste0("https://doi.org/", gsub("^https?://doi.org/", "", tolower(doi)))
}

infer_repo_slug <- function(meta) {
  repo <- meta$repo %||% meta$paper$study_repo %||% meta$paper$package_repo %||% NULL
  if (is.null(repo) || !nzchar(as.character(repo[[1]]))) {
    return("replicate-anything/registry")
  }
  as.character(repo[[1]])
}

papers_dir <- "papers"
yml_files <- list.files(papers_dir, pattern = "\\.yml$", full.names = FALSE)
folders <- sort(sub("\\.yml$", "", yml_files))

rows <- lapply(folders, function(folder) {
  yml_file <- file.path(papers_dir, paste0(folder, ".yml"))
  if (!file.exists(yml_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  meta <- tryCatch(
    yaml::read_yaml(yml_file),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(meta) || is.null(meta$paper)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  paper <- meta$paper
  doi <- field_or(paper$doi)
  href <- doi_href(doi)

  data.frame(
    folder = folder,
    doi = doi,
    doi_href = href,
    title = field_or(paper$title),
    journal = field_or(paper$journal),
    year = field_or(paper$year, NA),
    authors = format_authors(paper$authors),
    repo = infer_repo_slug(meta),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

papers <- if (length(rows) > 0) {
  do.call(rbind, rows)
} else {
  data.frame(
    folder = character(),
    doi = character(),
    doi_href = character(),
    title = character(),
    journal = character(),
    year = integer(),
    authors = character(),
    repo = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

index_csv <- papers[, c("folder", "doi", "title", "journal", "year", "authors", "repo")]
write.csv(index_csv, "index.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

if (nrow(papers) == 0) {
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(Message = "No paper stubs found in papers/*.yml."),
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE
  )
} else {
  display <- data.frame(
    Folder = sprintf(
      '<a href="papers/%s.yml">%s</a>',
      papers$folder,
      papers$folder
    ),
    DOI = ifelse(
      papers$doi_href != "",
      sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', papers$doi_href, papers$doi),
      papers$doi
    ),
    Title = papers$title,
    Journal = papers$journal,
    Year = papers$year,
    Authors = papers$authors,
    Repository = sprintf(
      '<a href="https://github.com/%s">%s</a>',
      papers$repo,
      papers$repo
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  knitr::kable(
    display,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped"'
  )
}
```
